translations.web: For wicked men are found among my people. They watch, as fowlers lie in wait. They set a trap. They catch men.
translations.bsb: For among My people are wicked men; they watch like fowlers lying in wait; they set a trap to catch men.
translations.kjv: For among my people are found wicked men: they lay wait, as he that setteth snares; they set a trap, they catch men.
